Home Depot:
Fewer Trips, Bigger Bills

lines.text: Home Depot shoppers made fewer trips, but paid more each time.
lines.say: Home Depot shoppers made fewer trips, but paid more each time.

lines.text: This morning Home Depot reported $43.4 billion in quarterly sales, up 4.9%.
lines.say: This morning, Home Depot reported about forty-three billion dollars in quarterly sales, up almost five percent.

lines.text: But look inside: comparable transactions fell 0.5%, while the average ticket rose 3.0%.
lines.say: But look inside: comparable transactions fell half a percent, while the average ticket rose three percent.

lines.text: The average receipt went from $90.39 to $93.09 in a year.
lines.say: The average receipt went from about ninety dollars and forty cents to about ninety-three dollars in a year.

lines.text: And that gap keeps growing: ticket growth went from 1.8% a year ago to 3.0% now.
lines.say: And that gap keeps growing: ticket growth went from one point eight percent a year ago to three percent now.

lines.text: In February, the company tied bigger tickets partly to some price increases and shoppers trading up.
lines.say: In February, the company tied bigger tickets partly to some price increases and shoppers trading up.

lines.text: For you: if hardware store receipts feel bigger, the numbers agree. You're not imagining it.
lines.say: For you: if hardware store receipts feel bigger, the numbers agree. You're not imagining it.

lines.text: Takeaway: track what each trip costs, not just how often you go.
lines.say: Takeaway: track what each trip costs, not just how often you go.

post.ig:
Home Depot shoppers made fewer trips, but paid more each time.
Home Depot reported Q3 sales of $43.4 billion on Nov 17, 2026, up 4.9% from a year ago.
Comparable customer transactions fell 0.5%, while the comparable average ticket rose 3.0%.
The average receipt rose to $93.09 from $90.39. Ticket growth has climbed from 1.8% a year ago.
Sources: The Home Depot Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings release (Nov 17, 2026); CNBC; MarketBeat.
